scope: All 24 Las Vegas restaurants in the inaugural 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest (4 starred, 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended). Source list: S01/S02 (official Michelin release). Area and cuisine labels: S03 (LVCVA). A blank value means it was NOT confirmed from an official source and is flagged.
price_basis: Price for 2 adults: no official menu or per-person price was retrieved, so every row is blank (unverified). Michelin/guide price symbols are shown only where the official restaurant page printed them.
social_basis: No restaurant-specific YouTube, TikTok or Instagram account was confirmed from an official page this session. Blank = not verified (flagged F19).
